name: avatar
description: A person, never an empty circle. Initials come from the name; a photo overlays them when ready.
avoidWhen: Do not use for a brand mark or a generic icon; pass a person's name.

ux.behaviour: A name always becomes one or two initials; TalkBack reads the name
ux.why: An empty circle is a missing person

ux.behaviour: An image slot overlays the initials when the photo is ready; the name stays the description
ux.why: The photo can arrive late without the circle going blank first

aiHints: Pass the person's name, not initials; the item derives them
The image slot is optional; do not hide the avatar while Coil loads
